title: Forbidden overlap and callback retirement contracts

projects.scope: Whole-descriptor overlap rejection and failure preservation; lifetime/extents remain caller preconditions.

limits: Existing accepted units remain unchanged; these laboratory anchors attach to required additive AX criteria.
No thread synchronization, foreign callback, physical target execution or arbitrary dangling-pointer validation is claimed.
